shared_elements: frontal or profile figures with outstretched limbs
justification: Both surfaces depict anthropomorphic figures with limbs outstretched, and A includes small stick figures with raised arms while B is a single winged bird-headed human, so only the generic 'human figure' category is shared. A is a sprawling multi-figure hunting scene of tiny monochrome silhouettes with many animals scattered across a long horizontal band, whereas B is one large, centred, bilaterally symmetrical, elaborately costumed composite being with outlined and patterned infill, zigzag arch and beaded ornaments — different subject, scale, arrangement and drawing convention.
